name: NEVERMORE ~Yongliu Bi'an de Qiyuan~
source:
A short prequel and afterstory to NEVERMORE.

If only I could turn back time to December 12th, 1999, the day before the end began and the reckoning came due. I can still see those ordinary boys and girls in their ordinary city. I remember how we laughed, how happy we were. I knew it would all change soon, but in that moment all I wanted was to lose myself in the beauty of it. The sun hung low, and the evening street glittered with flecks of gold. Our long, long shadows lay across it, unbroken as my memory of those smiling faces, stretching all the way back to our feet.

If we were to awaken from this dream, let it be on December 25th, 2000, a year after the last judgement was passed and redemption was complete. In a forgotten city, those who themselves have been forgotten still carry those distant memories of pain and sorrow, branded so vividly upon their hearts. He knew it had all been settled long ago, but in that moment all he wanted was to give himself over to the pain. Snow swirled around him. Alone on that empty stretch of white, he could feel the cold, the bitter cold, on every side. It lingered like the memory of all those days and nights he had struggled through. He had no desire to forget.

This time, we bring you the stories of those people who inhabit these tiny, little fragments of a much larger tale. These are stories of their own lives, before it all began and after it was over...

What hopes and memories are yet to come, and which have already drifted away?
The song has already risen, and the raven’s feathers are fated to fall.
Judgement and elegy ever walk hand in hand; redemption and lamentation are never far apart.
Coming in 2011, to end what has begun...
